notes.title: U4iA - Season 1 is now Live.
notes.notes: [p]It's been a lot of hard work, but it's finally out.[/p][p][/p][p]And whether you played my first game or not, I hope you have as much fun playing U4iA, as I had creating it.[/p][p][/p][p]If you find a bug that somehow got through to the release, let me know, and I'll squash it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]And please leave a review. It helps visibility.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks, and cheers.[/p][p]// Drifty[/p]
